description:
Fix the custom bottom-bar icon renderer.

The decompiler aliases com.reddit.ui.compose.ds to a different display package. Reflection must use the actual DEX class name, com.reddit.ui.compose.ds.q9. The old lookup failed and drew the original Home icon instead.

- NSFW now renders Reddit's blur-content icon: outlined 18 when off, filled 18 when on.
- Correct the same lookup for Vertical, so it displays the video icon.
- Preserve the separate NSFW slot, Inbox behavior, silent normal operation, failure toasts, filtering and confirmed-settings refresh.

All 21 patches applied successfully; ten local regression checks passed. Authenticated emulator screenshots verify both NSFW icon states and the Vertical icon. Both toggle directions completed without icon errors or crashes.

Refresh the existing Morphe source and repatch Reddit 2026.14.0 with your usual upstream patches.
